## Log #0236: Session summary 2026-11-23: NDX 26746.10 (+6.86%)

Date: 2026-11-24 07:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0236/


**Session date:** 2026-11-23

> *Session close 2026-11-23: NDX 26746.10 (+6.86%), NQ 26812.50, QQQ 650.87 (+7.00%).*

---

### Session overview

**Overnight and opening.** The NQ contract resumed trading on Sunday at 18:00 ET (Monday 0:00 PL) at 25561.50, 270.50 pts above Friday's last trade (25291.00). At 9:00 ET it stood at 26682.25 and at 9:30 ET at 26878.50. The session started at 9:30 ET (15:30 PL) at NDX level 26889.29, 1860.30 pts (+7.43%) above Friday's close (25028.99).

**First hour.** In the first 15 minutes NDX fell to the day's low of 26386.42 (between 9:40 and 9:45 ET, 15:40–15:45 PL), 502.87 pts below the open. Within the first 30 minutes NQ set both the session high, 27137.00, and the session low, 26450.25. NDX then rose 632.46 pts to the day's high of 27018.88 (between 10:25 and 10:30 ET, 16:25–16:30 PL).

**Rest of the session.** From 11:00 ET to the close NDX moved within 26573.28–26875.53 (302.25 pts). In the last hour it rose 28.44 pts, from 26717.66 at 15:00 ET to the close of 26746.10. The close is 272.78 pts below the high and 359.68 pts above the day's low.

**Flows and market breadth.** Cumulative flow (CVD) at the close was negative in NDX (−329,44 M) and QQQ (−3,82 M), while in NQ it stayed positive throughout the cash session. In QQQ the last quarter-hour of the session lowered it from −1,74 M. TICKQ market breadth at the close was -109.00.

**Companies.** Before the open CRWD released its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 (6:04 ET) and filed an agreement to acquire Zscaler (6:15 ET).

**Day's balance.** The Nasdaq-100 index closed with an increase of 6.86%. The close is 229.08 pts above the 19.11 close recorded by Heniu (26517.02).

## Fundamentals #0093: CrowdStrike: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-23 17:06
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-23-0093/


CrowdStrike (CRWD) revenue increased in the quarter by 28.3% year over year to 1.58 billion USD, and earnings per share was 0.02 USD compared to −0.03 USD a year earlier.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share was 0.34 USD compared to 0.24 USD a year earlier (+41.7% year over year). Net income reached 24.86 million USD compared to −26.78 million USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 at a level of 1,638.10 million USD – 1,644.10 million USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027 at a level of 0.36 USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that the better-than-planned results are a result of sales pressure, gross margin improvement, and greater operational efficiency. According to management, security has become a driving force, and the company is becoming an entry point for deploying AI in enterprises. Management believes that the timing for the acquisition is right and points to long-term preparations for technology integration. According to management, the combination with the new entity will allow it to become the largest company in the field of AI security.

### Logbook: Gravitational Collapse and Transition to Instability

**1. Weekly Trajectory and Price Volatility (Session overview Monday–Friday)**
In the studied cycle, a drastic degradation of the trajectory of all objects occurred. the NDX Star transitioned from the 27950.96 level to 25033.41, representing a drop of 10.44% (delta -2917.55 pts). The amplitude of NDX fluctuations was 2719.54 pts, with a low extreme at the 24979.04 level. the NQ Probe showed an even greater amplitude (3207.25 pts), falling from 28036.58 to 25274.25 (-9.85%). the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) correlated its movement with the system, losing 10.28% of its value (from 679.91 to 610.04 USD). The entire week was characterized by rapid compression and the search for new, lower levels of stability.

**2. Energy Balance and Cumulative Fuel (Weekly CVD and Volume)**
A deep divergence in energy flows occurred. While NDX recorded a positive CVD balance (+294.39 M) indicating euphoria in the cash sector, the NQ Probe (-290.57 K) and the QQQ Dyson Sphere (-15.69 M) showed accumulated panic. Aggressive volume in derivatives and ETFs was directed toward a sell-off, suggesting that despite local attempts at accretion in the cash market, the driving mechanics of contracts and funds were dominated by a rapid outflow of liquidity.

**3. Mass Evolution, Core Density, and Option Shields**
The total mass of the system (T-Mass) underwent rapid dispersion: a drop from 39.64 trillion USD to 35.57 trillion USD (-10.26%). Despite the loss of mass, the Core density increased slightly by 0.27 pp (to 68.93%). Core composition fluctuation showed rotation: on Thursday, the value of WMT fell below 1 trillion USD, only to exceed the 1 trillion USD threshold again on Friday. Average action fell by 12.20% ($253.50). The system recorded an extreme increase in tension within option shields – implied volatility (IV) increased by 11.84 pp compared to the beginning of the week, reaching the 40.88% level. The average TICKQ SMA200 radiation at the -78.48 level confirms a state of breakdown in the system's physics.

**Quantum Verdict:**
The system is in a phase of rapid decompression. High volatility (IV) and strong negative radiation indicate structural instability. The balance of forces after the cycle close is heavily shifted toward supply, despite attempts to stabilize mass within the Core.

**Status:** EXTERNAL OBSERVATION. Shields active.

**End of log.**

## Fundamentals #0090: Ross Stores: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-20 01:06
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-20-0090/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-24)**  
> **The comparison with Q2 did not mention the tariff refunds.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - Q2 operating income (1.10 billion USD) included about 253 million USD of IEEPA tariff refunds (company release of August 20, 2026).
>
> The other figures and dates stay the same.

Ross Stores (ROST) revenue increased in the quarter by 11.7% year over year to 6.26 billion USD, and earnings per share increased by 20.9% year over year to 1.91 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 766.79 million USD compared to 648.50 million USD a year earlier (+18.2% year over year). Net income reached 606.32 million USD compared to 511.94 million USD a year earlier (+18.4% year over year). Operating income on a quarterly basis was 766.79 million USD compared to 1.10 billion USD in Q2 (−30.5% q/q).

### Company guidance

The company expects comparable store sales growth in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 at a level of 4.0% – 5.0%. The company forecasts earnings per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 in the range of 2.16–2.25 USD, with earnings per share growth during this period expected to be 8.0% – 13.0%. The company also forecasts earnings per share for the full fiscal year 2026 in the range of 8.75–8.84 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that growth is being driven mainly by increased foot traffic in stores and the addition of new and returning customers. According to management, the company still sees significant opportunities for gaining market share, and many initiatives are in the early stages. Management stated that the company does not feel competitive pricing pressure that could harm its business. According to management, during the holiday season, results may be weighed down by more expensive domestic transportation and higher expenditures on store wages and marketing.

## Fundamentals #0089: Intuit: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-20 01:03
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-20-0089/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-24)**  
> **The entry did not say that the company lowered its full-year revenue guidance.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - On August 25, 2026 the company guided fiscal year 2027 revenue at 23.279–23.512 billion USD; on November 19, 2026 it gave 23.081–23.365 billion USD. According to the release, the change concerns Credit Karma, with an adjustment to the Consumer segment.
>
> The company reaffirmed its fiscal year 2027 guidance for operating income and earnings per share. The other figures and dates stay the same.

Intuit (INTU) revenue grew 12.1% year over year in the quarter to 4.35 billion USD, and earnings per share were 2.59 USD compared to 1.59 USD a year earlier (+62.9% year over year).

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 868.00 million USD compared to 534.00 million USD a year earlier (+62.5% year over year). Net income reached 695.00 million USD compared to 446.00 million USD a year earlier (+55.8% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share were 2.91 USD compared to 1.87 USD a year earlier (+55.6% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue for fiscal year 2027 at 23.081 billion USD – 23.365 billion USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in fiscal year 2027 in the range of 22.88 USD – 23.12 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized confidence regarding the execution of margin plans and full-year commitments. According to management, a strategy based on an AI-powered platform is key to winning in the market. Management indicated that experience with TurboTax and QuickBooks will improve Credit Karma's visibility over time. Management also announced that upon closing the transaction, all cash from the sale of Mailchimp will be used for share buybacks.

## Fundamentals #0088: Walmart: 3Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-19 17:34
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-19-0088/


Walmart (WMT) revenue grew in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 5.2% year over year to 188.84 billion USD, while earnings per share fell by 19.5% year over year to 0.62 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 7.77 billion USD compared to 6.70 billion USD a year earlier (+16.0% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share reached 0.65 USD compared to 0.62 USD a year earlier (+4.8% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects net sales growth at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2027 to be in the range of 4.9% – 5.2%. The company forecasts adjusted operating income growth at constant exchange rates in fiscal year 2027 in the range of 8.0% – 8.6%. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in fiscal year 2027 to be in the range of 2.84–2.89 USD. The company forecasts that capital expenditures as a percentage of net sales in fiscal year 2027 will be approximately 4.0%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that e-commerce was the main driver for the quarter and that the company continues to gain market share. According to management, AI agents are starting to play an increasing role in shopping, and the company is well-prepared for new ways of buying. Management emphasized that results for the combined membership package are encouraging and the company's goal is to build the most essential membership in the United States. According to management, the growth of e-commerce is driving the growth of profitable services, such as advertising, the seller platform, or membership. Management emphasized that the customer remains stable and resilient, and operating income will grow faster than sales next year.

## Fundamentals #0086: Palo Alto Networks: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-19 00:53
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-19-0086/


Palo Alto Networks (PANW) revenue grew 39.2% year over year to 3.45 billion USD, and earnings per share grew 21.3% year over year to 0.57 USD.

### Quarterly results

Net income was 482.00 million USD compared to 334.00 million USD a year earlier (+44.3% year over year). Adjusted earnings per share was 1.05 USD compared to 0.93 USD a year earlier (+12.9% year over year). Operating income was 96.00 million USD compared to 309.00 million USD a year earlier (−68.9% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 3.53 billion USD – 3.55 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 14.52 billion USD – 14.57 billion USD. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 to be 1.01–1.03 USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 to reach the level of 4.26–4.30 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand was broad, and all of the company's platforms accelerated revenue growth. According to management, higher component costs across the industry will weigh on gross margin throughout the fiscal year. Management emphasized that demand for computing power will grow, however, the company intends to invest prudently and maintain high free cash flow margins even during periods of higher capital expenditures. According to management, companies are still in a very early stage of AI implementation, and most agent applications are still in the testing and pilot phase.

NVIDIA (NVDA) revenue grew by 103.2% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 to 115.84 billion USD, and earnings per share grew by 107.7% year over year to 2.70 USD.

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 74.8% compared to 73.4% a year earlier (+1.4 pp year over year). Operating income reached 77.52 billion USD compared to 36.01 billion USD a year earlier (+115.3% year over year), and net income was 65.29 billion USD compared to 31.91 billion USD a year earlier (+104.6% year over year). Revenue in the Compute & Networking segment was 106.0 billion USD compared to 50.9 billion USD a year earlier (+108% year over year). ### Company guidance

### Management commentary

According to management, the company has secured supplies of memory and advanced chip packaging. ## Fundamentals #0081: Cisco Systems: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-13 13:47
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-13-0081/


Cisco Systems (CSCO) revenue increased by 24.4% in the quarter to 18.52 billion USD, and earnings per share increased by 58.3% to 1.14 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 5.60 billion USD compared to 3.36 billion USD a year earlier (+66.5% y/y). Net income reached 4.55 billion USD compared to 2.86 billion USD a year earlier (+59.2% y/y). Adjusted earnings per share was 1.40 USD compared to 1.00 USD a year earlier (+40.0% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company forecasts revenue in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 18.00 billion USD – 18.20 billion USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 at 74.80 billion USD – 75.80 billion USD. The company expects adjusted gross margin in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 65.0% – 66.0%. The company forecasts adjusted operating margin in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 36.0% – 37.0%. The company expects adjusted earnings per share in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 1.34–1.36 USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 5.47 USD – 5.53 USD. The company forecasts earnings per share (GAAP) in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 1.07–1.09 USD, and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 4.38–4.44 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the company is at the beginning of a large networking investment cycle driven by AI deployments. According to management, earnings are growing faster than revenue, indicating strong operating leverage. Management emphasized that hyperscalers are already deploying network architectures that connect multiple data centers for AI workloads. According to management, enterprise customers are investing in their own data centers as well as in running AI applications in the cloud. Management emphasized that the company does business with neocloud-type companies, while remaining cautious regarding their credit risk. According to management, component supply is stable, and the company expects to achieve its raised annual guidance.

## Fundamentals #0079: Nebius: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-12 16:57
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-12-0079/


Nebius (NBIS) revenue grew 571.3% year over year in the quarter to 980.80 million USD, while earnings per share was −0.13 USD compared to −0.50 USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in 2026 to be in the range of 3.00 billion USD to 3.40 billion USD, currently expecting the lower end of this range. The company forecasts revenue in 2027 in the range of 12.00 billion USD – 13.00 billion USD. The company expects capital expenditures in 2026 to be around 27.00 billion USD, which is a value above the previous range of 20–25 billion USD. The company forecasts capital expenditures in 2027 to be in the range of 40.00 billion USD to 45.00 billion USD. The company expects adjusted EBITDA margin in 2026 to be around 40.0%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand for artificial intelligence is real and large, and building capacity and its financing are solvable tasks. According to management, customers are committing for longer, at higher prices and paying more upfront, which has made prepayments a standard element of contracts. Management emphasized that at its own locations, the company is on or even ahead of schedule, although there are delays at some colocation locations, of which customers are being informed. According to management, none of this capacity has been canceled, and the company will be ready for the moment when supply and demand in the industry balance out.

## Fundamentals #0077: CoreWeave: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-11 00:50
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-11-0077/


CoreWeave (CRWV) revenue increased in the third quarter by 168.2% year over year to 3.66 billion USD, while earnings per share was −1.27 USD compared to −0.22 USD a year earlier.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 207.00 million USD compared to 52.00 million USD a year earlier (+298.1% year over year). Operating margin was 6% compared to 4% a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in 2026 at a level of 13.00 billion USD – 13.30 billion USD. The company forecasts adjusted operating income in 2026 at a level of 1.275 billion USD – 1.375 billion USD. The company expects active capacity at the end of the year to be over 1.85 GW. The company forecasts capital expenditures in 2026 at a level of 37.00 billion USD – 39.00 billion USD. The company expects interest costs in the fourth quarter of 2026 at a level of 1.05 billion USD – 1.15 billion USD. The company forecasts an annualized revenue run rate at the end of the year at a level of 20.00 billion USD – 21.00 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand for computing power is growing faster than the ability to deliver infrastructure, as seen in the increasing margins on subsequent contracts. According to management, demand and prices are strengthening, which helps the company achieve better returns on investment. Management emphasized that at current profitability levels, the company does not need to finance itself with unsecured debt. According to management, the company does not expect the impact of a major regulatory change in the USA, as data centers have permits and are under construction. Management emphasized that the Forge platform represents the first step for corporate clients to utilize the company's infrastructure.

## Fundamentals #0076: Rocket Lab: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-10 16:41
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-10-0076/


Rocket Lab (RKLB) revenue increased in the third quarter by 72.7% year over year to 267.83 million USD, while earnings per share were −0.12 USD compared to −0.03 USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in the fourth quarter of 2026 in the range of 270.00 million USD – 290.00 million USD. The company forecasts gross margin (GAAP) at 34.0% – 36.0%, and adjusted gross margin at 39.0% – 41.0% in the fourth quarter of 2026. The company forecasts operating expenses (GAAP) in the fourth quarter of 2026 at 162.00 million USD – 168.00 million USD, while adjusted operating expenses are at 136.00 million USD – 142.00 million USD. The company expects net interest income of 45.00 million USD in the fourth quarter of 2026. The company forecasts adjusted EBITDA in the fourth quarter of 2026 at −20.00 million USD – −14.00 million USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that there is a lack of capacity in the rocket launch market, which was anticipated by the company. According to management, after the fabrication of a new Neutron rocket tank dome, the issue with the faulty component has been resolved, although the tank is awaiting testing. Management emphasized that an exact debut date for the Neutron rocket will not be provided until the tank passes all tests. According to management, with rising demand, higher prices for Electron and HASTE launches should be expected. Management emphasized that the company could have signed more Neutron launch contracts, but decided on higher prices with fewer launches. According to management, negative cash flows will not permanently reverse before the Neutron rocket enters production without the acquired Iridium, and the picture is expected to change after the closing of the acquisition.
